title: 09 Pagewright: on-call page
strengths: Reads in one glance, in the right order: the 'SEV 1' tag, 'card-auth', 'Declines 31%, usually 4%', 'Open 14 min · INC-2291', then who is on it. Every mark is a fact or an action
One red used once, on the severity tag, with black text; no glow, rings, wordmark or gradient. It is the opposite of the old Hush orb
watchOS layout holds at 100%: the clock top right, one 18 px left edge, two full-width capsule buttons; the bottom capsule clears the 48 px display corner by about 2 px
slop_signals: Step order: 'Noor, Bastian on it' for 'Open 14 min' means someone already acknowledged the page, yet the primary button is 'Acknowledge'. An SRE buyer will notice: a page for an incident others are working is a responder request ('Join' or 'Accept'), not an acknowledgement
Conventional rather than ownable: a clean long-look notification that any on-call tool could ship; nothing in it is Pagewright's own
The two stacked buttons fill about 40% of the display, and the bottom capsule sits about 2 px from the display's corner curve, which looks cramped at full size
The initials discs 'NA' and 'BL' add a second way of saying who is on it, beside 'Noor, Bastian on it'
fixes: Fix the logic in one of two ways: make the primary 'Join incident' (secondary 'Escalate to tier 2'), or make it a fresh page nobody has taken ('Noor paged 3 min ago, no ack') and keep 'Acknowledge'

Drop the initials discs and keep the line 'Noor, Bastian on it'; use the freed row for one piece of data only this product has, such as a small 30-minute decline-rate trace that shows the step at 02:58
Inset the action stack 4 px more from the bottom so the lower capsule does not touch the corner curve

references.what: Alarm triggered: one statement, then two stacked full-width actions. The piece matches this structure and its quality
Outages: black, technical, times and durations in a column, red used only on the events. The same sober register, with data as the picture
An issue ID and status as plain metadata above the title; the piece's 'INC-2291' line does the same
A dark alert with one plain headline and one action, the numbers under it carrying the urgency

fixed: Main button now reads 'Join incident': two responders already acknowledged the page (orchestrator, 2026-10-14)

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay

round4.pairwise: won 4 vs PagerDuty, won 5 vs New Relic, won 3 vs Opsgenie (blind, 18 Oct; tested before the audit fixes)
changed: One clear hierarchy: 'card-auth' small, 31% at 64 as the hero, one line 'of cards declined, usually 4%'
Second button moved below the fold; 'Join incident' is one dark watchOS platter inset from the corners
'Open 14 min', INC-2291 and 'Noor and Bastian on it' removed so nothing competes with the number; 'Sev 1' is red text instead of a filled tag
